text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear it?! The chimes heralding a 
changing of the guard. Did you see it?! A 
glimpse of her evolution into the 
"Overlord of the Century's End." —I felt 
it without a shadow of a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The history of horseshoes carved out by 
the "Golden Generation." The strong one 
meant to inherit it—is me.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
If so, the next target is... where the 
truly strong emerge victorious—the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)!
